problem.title: Infinite-cluster intersections with vertical fibers
problem.statement: Let $G$ be an infinite graph with $p_c(G)=1$. For Bernoulli percolation on $G\times\mathbb{Z}$, must every infinite cluster intersect each fiber $\{v\}\times\mathbb{Z}$ that it meets in infinitely many vertices almost surely?
